In older versions, simply changing the CPU overclock was enough to achieve a considerable FPS gain in the game. In these newer versions, this has been fixed; however, other settings have been added that significantly slow down the system. The configuration I'm using gives me around 15 FPS in the game and much more fluidity.

custom_settings.set_name: [note by sirpips: Config created from test by Luis Torrão (RG4xxxx, Dolphin Rt:Core v10.5)]
custom_settings.set_note:
Settings:
- Overclock = 0.60000000: slightly lowers virtual CPU clock to reduce load and improve stability on devices like RG35XX.
- CPUCore = 4: uses the latest, fastest JIT core.
- CPUThread = True: enables multi-threaded emulation (improves performance).
- DSPHLE = True: uses HLE audio (faster, less accurate but sufficient).
- SkipIPL = True: skips the console boot animation – faster startup.
- InternalResolution = 66.666...%: internal resolution at 66% – balance between graphics and FPS.
- NoMipmapping = True: disables mipmaps to reduce GPU load.
- VISkip = True: skips some vertex information – helps performance in 3D games.
- Backend = OpenSLES: changes audio backend from ALSA to OpenSLES for better muOS compatibility.
- Additional tweaks: BBoxEnable, EFBAccessEnable off, EFBEmulateFormatChanges off, VertexRounding, FastDepthCalc, ShaderCache, VSync off, ForceTrueColor, SkipDuplicateXFBs, EFBScaledCopy, SafeTextureCacheColorSamples=128.

I will run further tests with more stable profiles as soon as possible.
